clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he once watched Bill Gates answer the question everyone wants answered: what's the secret to success?

Gates told Larry King, live on CNN: right place, right time, see the potential, think big. Then he named the real difference. A lot of other people stood in that exact same spot, saw that exact same potential.

What he did that they didn't: he moved, immediately. "I'm impatient," Gates said. "I have to get things done yesterday."

Comment MONEY and I'll send you the training on taking that kind of action, straight to your messages.
